Topic: Generating Functions and Roots of Unity: The Combinatorial Secret Weapon

Target audience: University students (Mathematics/Computer Science majors)

Section: section_1 — The Intuitive Bridge: Generating Functions as Infinite Containers

Lecture lines:
Sequences hide inside power series coefficients.
Think of exponents as weight, coefficients as counts.
A single die becomes this polynomial.
[Asset: DicePolynomial] shows the outcome mapping.
Generating functions are powerful containers for counting.

Planned animations:
Display a sequence of discrete objects changing into a continuous function wave (#FFCC00).
Morph the function wave into a series of weighted powers (#00FFCC).
Highlight individual coefficient positions as containers for values (#FF00CC).

Section: section_2 — The Geometry of Selection: Complex Roots of Unity

Lecture lines:
We need to sum specific coefficients.
Roots of unity form regular polygons.
[Asset: RootsUnitCircle] shows these complex pointers.
Multiplying by ω acts as a filter.
This sieve cancels out unwanted terms.

Planned animations:
Render unit circle with points at Roots of Unity (#FFFFFF).
Connect the roots with a rotating vector line (#FF3399).
Show the vector's projection onto the real axis (#00CCFF).

Section: section_3 — Application: Counting Subsets with Constraints

Lecture lines:
Synthesize generation and modular constraints.
[Asset: SubsetPolynomial] maps subsets to weights.
Evaluate the polynomial at roots of unity.

Planned animations:
Visualize a set of items as a grid of circles (#00FF00).
Group the circles into subsets using bounding regions (#FF9900).
Display a target count anchor icon at the subset sum (#FF3333).

Section: section_4 — Summary and Visualization Strategy

Lecture lines:
Encode sequences into polynomials.
Rotate using roots of unity.
Average results to isolate specific sums.

Planned animations:
Show a summary table connecting algebraic and geometric views (#FFFFFF).
Cycle through the core concepts presented in previous sections (#CCFF00).
Display a final visual connection diagram between all topics (#FFFFFF).
